question: Does the first chronological IG1 signal with finite recorded delay 0..3 minutes have a first eligible raw ask within the literal 3% entry limit, and what displayed top-of-book ask size was reported? Capacity beyond that displayed quote, actual execution and profitability are not measured. Execution costs are reported separately.

selection.rule: IG1; finite delay in minutes 0..3 inclusive (NOT age, which is listing age in sessions); sort day, recorded minuteNY, symbol; no outcome/return criterion
selection.interpretation: Recorded09:48 minute -> hypothetical next-minute09:49; original second-level decision/delivery time unavailable and not invented.

economics.priceRule: Only first eligible raw ask <= 1.58105 determines literal price-rule pass/fail. Modeled ask*1.02, whole-share quantity, idle cash and USD3 buy fee are separate cost numbers, never an additional price-limit trigger.
economics.quoteRule: First regular positive noncrossed SIP quote (ap>=bp, locked quotes included) selected before price/size checks; ambiguous first timestamp -> INCONCLUSIVE. Continuation page not fetched; first-page result requires a later timestamp on that page or a terminal page to close first-timestamp ambiguity.
economics.holdingExit: NOT_ACQUIRED_NOT_EVALUATED; original IG1 close/8%stop rule remains untouched. No close-price inference or new exit rule.
economics.primaryHistoricalCostViews: Original IG1 percentage-friction view and handbook0.8%/1.2% plus applicable2%-side/3%-extended-hours remain required for any later outcome claim; this entry-only task cannot pass those round-trip gates.

terminal.quotedEntryFeasible: QUOTED_ENTRY_REFERENCE_PASSES: literal raw-ask limit holds and displayed top-of-book ask shares >= modeled whole-share quantity >=1. Weak displayed-liquidity evidence only, never proof of executable capacity.
terminal.quotedEntryFails: QUOTED_ENTRY_REFERENCE_FAILS only if the complete unambiguous first eligible raw ask exceeds the literal 3% limit. Modeled slippage and size do not reject the original strategy.
terminal.inconclusive: INCONCLUSIVE_FOR_CAPACITY if literal price rule passes but displayed size is below modeled quantity or quantity<1. INCONCLUSIVE for missing/invalid/partial/oversized evidence, no eligible quote, ambiguous first timestamp, or unclosed first-timestamp group on a nonterminal page. No retry or pagination. A continuation token alone does not prevent first-quote evaluation if a later timestamp on page1 closes its tie group.
terminal.always: Original receipt/delivery, actual fill, whole outcome chain, BOTH controls and profitability remain UNKNOWN/NOT_EVALUATED; no admissions, paper validation or live promotion.
